translate_en|mods/MaDZombieLootB42/commo: Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for finding ammo boxes. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for finding random loose ammo not necessarily associated with a spawned weapon. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier for contents of containers such as bags and gun cases that appear on zombies. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for bags such as shopping and grocery bags. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for canned food. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Percent chance items in dead zombie inventory will have 100%% condition
Percent chance that drainable items -- duct tape, glue, etc -- will be full

Additional items rolled for every zombie. Separate rules with semicolons. Global example: 'Base.BaseballBat:0.2'. Optional outfit example: 'Fireman:Base.Axe:0.05'. These can be mixed: 'Fireman:Base.Axe:0.05;Base.BaseballBat:0.2'. Advanced syntax is 'item:Base.Money,chance:0.1,more:10,moreChance:50,outfit:Police'; omit outfit for a global rule. Chances are percentages from 0 to 100 and may be decimal. Extra rolls are capped at 100.

Rules that match the zombie's outfit, plus global rules, form the eligible list. One eligible item is randomly chosen and rolled, so at most one item from this set is added. Examples: 'Base.BaseballBat:0.2' or 'Fireman:Base.Axe:0.05'. Advanced rules may add ',outfit:Police'. Chances are percentages from 0 to 100 and may be decimal.

Rules that match the zombie's outfit, plus global rules, form the eligible list. One eligible item is randomly chosen and rolled, so at most one item from this set is added. Examples: 'Base.BaseballBat:0.2' or 'Fireman:Base.Axe:0.05'. Advanced rules may add ',outfit:Police'. Chances are percentages from 0 to 100 and may be decimal.

Rules that match the zombie's outfit, plus global rules, form the eligible list. One eligible item is randomly chosen and rolled, so at most one item from this set is added. Examples: 'Base.BaseballBat:0.2' or 'Fireman:Base.Axe:0.05'. Advanced rules may add ',outfit:Police'. Chances are percentages from 0 to 100 and may be decimal.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for sandbox-defined items below. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Global multiplier for all zombie loot added by this mod. A value of 100 here will be 1x default distribution; 200 will be 2x; 50 will be 1/2; etc
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for gun cases. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for junk such as rubber bands and empty bottles. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for finding long guns such as rifles and shotguns. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to loose bullets spawned with and without guns. Separate from Ammo Multiplier. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.

Maximum size of a loose-ammunition bundle spawned with a gun. When the loose-bullet chance succeeds, the mod adds a random number from 1 through this value. Set to 0 to disable loose bullets. Values are limited to 25.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for finding melee weapons. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Minimum condition of items found. 0 means broken. Between 0 and 100
Minimum amount of drainable percent left in drainable items. Between 0 and 100.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for other food such as candy and chips. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Only applies to Brita weapons if that mod is enabled. Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for all outfit-specific items. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for finding pistols. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.

Items to remove from zombie loot added by this mod. Separate them with semicolons. For example, 'Axe;Money;Newspaper;Radio.WalkieTalkie5' removes Axe, Money, Newspaper, and Walkie Talkie 5 from regular and outfit-specific loot. For items in the Base module, such as 'Base.Axe', omit 'Base.' from the item name. This does not affect vanilla drops or drops added by other mods.
Multiplier applied to built-in probabilities for resources such as tape and glue. A value of 100 is 1x the default distribution; 200 is 2x; 50 is 0.5x.
